preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and n >= 1 and n <= 500000
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 5·10^5) representing the number of people excluding Bob.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()[1:]) == n and all(0 <= int(a) <= n for a in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: The second line of stdin contains exactly n integers a₁, a₂, ..., aₙ (0 ≤ aᵢ ≤ n) representing the number of friends each of the n people has.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(int(x) >= 0 and int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split()) and len(set(stdout.split())) == len(stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: If no valid degree sequence exists for Bob (including his own degree), stdout is '-1'. Otherwise, stdout contains all possible values of Bob's degree (a_{n+1}) in strictly increasing order, each between 0 and n (inclusive), with no duplicates.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= n for k in [int(x) for x in stdout.split()]) if stdout.strip() != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: Each possible value of Bob's degree (a_{n+1}) is a non-negative integer between 0 and n (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: any(all(sum(1 for i in range(n) if (a[i] > 0 and a[j] > 0 and i != j)) == n for a in [list(map(int, stdin.split()[1:])) + [k] for k in [int(x) for x in stdout.split()]] if stdout.strip() != '-1')
postconditions.description: For each possible value k of Bob's degree, the combined degree sequence (a₁, ..., aₙ, k) must be graphical (i.e., there exists an undirected graph with n+1 vertices where the degree of each vertex matches the sequence).
